units.source_text: 我觉得郁闷，老待在对局的旅馆里实在吃不消，

en.t: Feeling depressed, I really could not bear staying any longer at the inn where the match was being played,

units.source_text: 就躲进塔之泽的福住楼，写了一回围棋观战记，

en.t: so I slipped away to Fukuzumiro in Tōnosawa and wrote one installment of my go match report,

units.source_text: 第二天便回到轻井泽的山中小屋去了。

en.t: and the next day I went back to my mountain cottage in Karuizawa.
